title: Baby Feeding Log
description: Log nursing and bottle sessions with timestamps, daily totals, saved in your browser.
howto: For nursing enter side and minutes; for bottle enter milliliters.
The time defaults to now; change it if logging later.
See today's totals and full history; delete mistakes.

faqs.a: Only in your browser's localStorage. Nothing is uploaded.

faqs.q: Can I log for a different day?
faqs.a: Yes. Change the date/time field before adding the session.

faqs.q: What do the daily totals show?
faqs.a: Number of sessions, total nursing minutes, and total bottle milliliters for the selected date.
